in_sanskrit.name: Krītī
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power to create, craft, or possesses a high level of skill.

in_hindi.name: क्रीती
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who creates, crafts, or possesses a high level of skill. Derived from the word कृतिका (Krītikā) meaning 'creative, crafty, skillful'.

in_tamil.name: க்ரீடீ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who creates, crafts, or possesses a high level of skill. Derived from the Tamil word கீழ்ப்படியால் (kīḻppaṭiyāl) meaning 'below' and ஒப்பரியால் (oppariyāl) meaning 'possessing'.

in_telugu.name: క్రీదీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who creates, crafts, or possesses a high level of skill. Derived from the Telugu words చేశణ (cheśaṇa) meaning 'power, ability, skill' and దేశేశ (deśeśa) meaning 'lord, master'.

in_marathi.name: Kreeti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Creativity, innovation, talent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kreeti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kreeti is a Sanskrit name that symbolizes creativity, innovation, and talent. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'krit', meaning 'to create'. The name is often given to children who are believed to have exceptional artistic abilities or a strong inclination towards innovation and creativity.
